findings.confirmed_example: A later legacy renderCurrency implementation is short-circuited by ensureCurrencyShell() returning null after removing the stale shell; this is compatibility/override layering rather than an active second renderer.
findings.risk: Accumulated renderer/global override layers increase maintenance and restyling risk even when current runtime output is stable.

post_checkpoint_priority: Create a single canonical renderer per major view
Remove or archive superseded compatibility renderers
Keep data/model logic isolated from presentation cleanup
Re-run browser and engine invariance gates after cleanup
